cells.value: Schema: core - prepared 06 Nov 2026 from 'Mahera_Data_Dictionary_FinalLast3.xlsx' with the 05 Nov 2026 DB review fixes applied

Every table, column and allowed value of Mahera Muskan's 4 tables (as per team allocation): notification_category_preferences, device_tokens, connections, relations. Other members' tables are not included.
New or modified compared with the original workbook. The 'Change' column says exactly what changed. Removed items are listed in 'What Changed'.
Tables -> Data Dictionary (every column) -> Value Lists (table > column > values) -> Relationships.
Every user reference is <column> UUID REFERENCES core.users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT. core.users belongs to the identity team.

ON DELETE RESTRICT everywhere. Columns, types and rules come from the reviewed data dictionary; status lists are named CHECKs. Dropped values are in Values Not Kept. Three supporting registry tables (notification_categories, notification_category_channels, connection_closed_reasons) hold the controlled values.
PK = primary key. FK = link to another table. UNIQUE = no duplicates. CHECK = rule the database enforces.
What changed from the original workbook
Review fixes applied in this dictionary.
notification_category_preferences, device_tokens, connections, relations (team allocation). Reviewed against the DB review comments of 05 Nov 2026.

preferences: id (PK), priority_level, preferred_notification_period, snoozed_from, snoozed_until. device_tokens: token_nonce, token_key_version, token_fingerprint, expires_at, invalidated_at. connections: connection_source, closed_by_type, last_interaction_at, interaction_count. relations: relation_source, is_mutual, non_mutual_reason, expires_at.
core.notification_categories, core.notification_category_channels, core.connection_closed_reasons - hold the controlled values and allowed combinations (see Relationships).
UUID, FK -> core.users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT.
~60 labels -> 38 stable codes in a registry. 8 mandatory notices cannot be disabled; newsletter_marketing needs consent. Missing preference row = enabled.
in_app, push, email only (sms, whatsapp not kept); only allowed channel/category pairs can be stored.
Not kept here - held in another team member's table. This table keeps only snoozed_from / snoozed_until.

Providers apns, fcm, webpush, wns; new platform column with verified provider/platform pairs; token_hash -> token_fingerprint (HMAC-SHA-256); AES-256-GCM only, with nonce + key version; Web Push stored as an encrypted subscription.
10 values -> active, paused, closed. Request stages stay in core.connection_requests.
48 values -> 41 governed codes (19 from the review + 22 proposed, need approval), each tied to an actor type; block direction via closed_by_user_id.
Duplicate active actions blocked; relation_source and non_mutual_reason limited to approved codes; expiry added.
From her sheet - like, wave, endorse, react (needs product approval; 'save' not kept).

Only verified provider / platform pairs: apns -> ios, ipados, macos; fcm -> android; wns -> windows; webpush -> web. Linux stays disabled until verified.
Encrypted raw token, needed to send pushes.

AES-256-GCM only; key in Vault / KMS; never log plaintext. No AES-CTR, no CBC without MAC, no RSA for the token. Web Push: the whole subscription (endpoint, p256dh, auth) is stored here as encrypted JSON.
Modified: AES-256-GCM approved; Web Push handling
Nonce used for the AES-256-GCM encryption.
Made by the vetted library; never reused with the same key. UNIQUE (token_key_version, token_nonce); CHECK length = 12.
KMS / Vault key version used to encrypt this token.
Supports key rotation. Key material is never stored in the database; only the push sender may decrypt.
Keyed fingerprint used to find / de-duplicate a token without decrypting it.

HMAC key kept in Vault / KMS, separate from the encryption key. UNIQUE (provider, token_fingerprint) WHERE status = 'active'. For Web Push it is computed from the endpoint. Same token from another user: the old row is revoked in the same transaction.
Named CHECK. Revoke on logout; invalid when the provider rejects it permanently. Revoked, invalid and expired tokens are never sent. revoked_at, invalidated_at and expires_at must agree with status.
Date and time; NULL if unknown
When the token expires, if known.
Later than created_at. Expired tokens are not sent. 90-day purge is proposed, not approved.
Date and time; NULL unless revoked
Filled exactly when status = 'revoked'; >= created_at; updated with status in one step.
Date and time; NULL unless invalid
When the provider permanently rejected the token.
Filled exactly when status = 'invalid'; set atomically and retries stop. Temporary errors use bounded exponential backoff and never invalidate.
CHECK user_low_id < user_high_id (also blocks self-pairs). INDEX on both ids.
One open (active / paused) connection per pair (partial UNIQUE); closed ones keep history.
Named CHECK. Request stages live in Prajwal's core.connection_requests; muted / archived are per-user view settings. 'restricted' needs moderation approval - not included.

Required when closed. Admin / system actors are explicit - never arbitrary user IDs.
User who disconnected / blocked (if a user did).
Must be user_low_id or user_high_id when closed_by_type = 'user'; NULL for admin / system. Replaces her blocked_by_user_low / high.
Updated in the same transaction as the message event; never moves backwards. Reconcile against message events.

Needs product approval ('save' not kept). Partial UNIQUE (actor_user_id, target_user_id, reaction_type, COALESCE(profile_prompt_id, 0)) WHERE status = 'active' stops duplicate active actions.
Named CHECK. Expiry and undo are idempotent; an undo wins only before expires_at.
Both users have qualifying actions toward each other.
Prefer deriving it from reciprocal eligible actions. If stored, update transactionally; TRUE only when both directions qualify.
Main reason the relation is not mutual.
NULL when is_mutual = TRUE; one reason (by precedence) when FALSE. Delivery or sync failures are never reasons.
Same key + same payload returns the original result; same key + different payload is rejected. Client / operation scope and retention still to be defined.
